LockNaturals.Name: Natural 1s and 20s lock RoBear-E Cards
LockNaturals.Hint: No RoBear-E Card can be played on a roll whose d20 shows a natural 1 or 20. Turn this off to allow Advantage and Inspiration on them. A natural 1 is fixed either way: Luck, Indomitable and Relentless never reroll one, and Luck can't be played on a natural 20.

ShowPlayedCards.Name: Show played cards on screen
ShowPlayedCards.Hint: When a RoBear-E Card is played, its art appears in the middle of the screen for a moment, for everyone who can see the roll. Either way, chat keeps a record of it, with a thumbnail of the card.

ShowDCDefault.Name: Show the DC to players by default
ShowDCDefault.Hint: Whether Show DC to Players starts ticked when you open the request window. You can still change it for each request. A hidden DC is kept off the chat card, but it still reaches each player's Foundry with the request, so it isn't a secret from a player who goes looking.

AttachRolls.Name: Attach rolls to the request card
AttachRolls.Hint: Rolls made for a roll request are shown on its card, rather than as messages of their own. Click a result on the card to see its dice.

PopupPlayers.Name: Pop up roll requests for players
PopupPlayers.Hint: When the GM posts a roll request, a window opens for each player with a character in it, with a Roll button for each of their characters. The chat card works either way.

PopupGM.Name: Pop up roll requests for the GM
PopupGM.Hint: When a roll request includes NPCs, or any actor no player owns, a window opens for the GM with their Roll buttons. Otherwise the GM rolls for them from the chat card.

Cards.NoneLeft: You have no RoBear-E Cards left until your next long rest.
Cards.ChooseFromSheet: Choose a card to play. It will be spent until your next long rest.
Cards.ChooseOnRoll: Choose a card to play on this roll. It will be spent until your next long rest.
Cards.NextRollAdvantage: {name}'s next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw will be made with advantage.
Cards.ButtonTooltip: Use a RoBear-E Card on this roll

Indomitable.ConfirmNoDC: This save has no DC, so it can't be checked whether it failed. Spend a use of {name} ({uses} left) to reroll it?

Bonus.NoTargets: There is no roll in chat this can be added to.
Bonus.SentToGM: Sent to the GM to apply.
Bonus.NoGM: That roll isn't yours to change, so a GM must be logged in to apply it.
Bonus.GMRefused: The GM couldn't apply your bonus roll: it has already been spent, or that roll can't take it.
Bonus.GMFailed: The GM couldn't apply your bonus roll. Nothing was spent.

Request.DeleteGMOnly: Only the GM can delete a roll made for a roll request.

Standard.Label: Standard Roll
Standard.Hint: Each actor rolls once against the DC.

Team.Label: Team Challenge
Team.Hint: The party's rolls are averaged. A natural 1 removes the highest roll, and a natural 20 the lowest.

Challenge.Label: Skill Challenge
Challenge.Hint: Each actor faces three rolls in turn, and needs enough of them to succeed.

RollOff.Label: Roll-Off
RollOff.Hint: Two actors roll against each other, and the higher total wins.

Versus.Label: Team vs Team
Versus.Hint: Two teams are averaged like a Team Challenge, and the higher average wins.

Divine.Label: Divine Intervention
Divine.Hint: Each actor picks a run of numbers, then must roll one of them on a d100.

Subtitle.Divine: {count} numbers in a row on a d100

Challenge.DoneTooltip: Finished. The GM will show how it went.

Result.Uncounted: Not counted: a changed DC decided the challenge before this roll. {result}

Divine.DialogHint: Pick {count} numbers in a row. You then roll a d100, and must roll one of them.
Divine.DialogHintOne: Pick a number. You then roll a d100, and must roll it.

EditDC.Title: Change DC
EditDC.Tooltip: Change the DC. Rolls already made are scored against the new one.
EditDC.Hint: Rolls already made are scored again against the new DC. Leave it blank for no DC.
EditDC.HintRequired: Rolls already made are scored again against the new DC.

Choose.Title: Choose a Roll: {name}
Choose.Hint: {name} may make any one of these rolls.

Reveal.ShownTooltip: Players can see this. Click to hide it.

RollAgain.Label: Roll again
RollAgain.Tooltip: Delete this roll, so {name} can roll again.
RollAgain.Title: Roll Again
RollAgain.Confirm: Delete {name}'s roll? Their Roll button comes back. Any card played on this roll stays spent.

Invalid.GMOnly: Only a GM can post a roll request.
Invalid.NoActors: A roll request needs at least one actor to roll.
Invalid.Actors: A roll request's actors must be a list of actor UUIDs, each named once.
Invalid.MissingRoll: A roll request is missing a roll.
Invalid.EmptySide: Each side of a contest needs at least one actor.
Invalid.RollOffSide: Each side of a Roll-Off needs exactly one actor.
Invalid.SideNotActor: Everyone on a side of a contest must also be in the request's actors.
Invalid.Key: Unknown {type} for a roll: {key}. Use one of: {keys}.
Invalid.DC: A DC must be a number, or null for none: {dc}.
Invalid.Successes: A skill challenge needs from 1 to {total} successes, not {successes}.
Invalid.Range: Divine Intervention needs from {min} to {max} numbers to pick, not {range}.
Invalid.DivineRoll: Divine Intervention's roll is a d100, not {type}.
Invalid.Choices: Only a Standard Roll, Team Challenge or Skill Challenge can offer a choice of rolls, and at most {max} to choose from, given as a list of alternatives.
Invalid.ChoiceDC: A Team Challenge's rolls are averaged against one DC, so its alternatives can't have DCs of their own.

Config.ChallengeHint: An actor stops rolling as soon as they have passed or failed the challenge.
Config.ContestHint: Each side makes its own roll, and the higher result wins.
Config.DivineHint: Each player picks this many numbers in a row, then rolls a d100 and must roll one of them.
Config.NoActors: Select tokens, or give players characters, to choose who rolls.
Config.ShowDCHint: Unticked, players see "DC ?" on the card. The DC still reaches their Foundry with the request, so this keeps the table honest rather than keeping a secret.
Config.PrivateHint: With private rolls, each player sees only their own results.
Config.BothSides: No one can be on both sides.
Config.ChooseActor: Choose at least one actor to roll.
Config.ChallengeDC: Each roll in a skill challenge needs a DC.
Config.AddChoice: Offer another roll to choose instead
